title: CB4-F: record 'not run (deadline)' for unsealed, incomplete h7 runs at T_seal 2026-10-22T00:00Z (dependency-free)
expected_value: the T_seal rule is recorded even if q0081/q0082 fail or never start
next_action: q0083 (depends on this); Claude session commits any NOT_RUN records
notes: Freeze-check fix 11. Before T_seal it prints {deadline_recorded: false, not_yet: ...} and exits 0 (a clean repeat run: no retry is burned; the worker re-queues it on the next tick, so it polls about every 2 minutes, mem 150 MB is exempt from the start blackout). At or after T_seal: every h7 run that is neither sealed nor complete is marked not_run_deadline (marker, manifest, seals/<run>_NOT_RUN.json); sealed or complete runs are left to q0083. Prints deadline_recorded true and ends. It takes a cpu-lane slot only for a second per tick. The worker has no not_before spec field (only retry backoff), hence the polling repeat.
